description: SIGRID is the disaster risk management information system of CENEPRED, Peru's national centre for disaster risk estimation, prevention and reduction, presented as a geospatial platform of official and up-to-date information. The portal read on 2026-09-28 offers a map viewer and sections for a document library, drone imagery, risk scenarios, EVAR risk assessments, plans, FONDES funding, reports and the SIGRID Collect field tool. Featured items include the national flood and mass movement risk scenario for the 2025 to 2027 multisectoral plan, built on rainfall anomalies of the strongest El Niño and La Niña events, a landslide hazard map for a village in Cajamarca from the geological survey INGEMMET, a risk scenario for rainfall warnings in March 2023, and drone imagery of the Costa Verde cliffs in Lima and a river overflow at Chilca. Coverage is Peru. Access is free on the web; the home page states no licence, and download options inside the viewer were not checked. Caveats: many products are reports and scenario maps, not raw layers. It supports hazard exposure and emergency planning studies, such as identifying districts and roads in El Niño flood and landslide scenarios. Related record: GeoCallao holds regional hazard layers for Callao.
